content: All rates are per-contract dollar amounts. Positive=rebate paid to firm. Negative=fee charged to firm. Normalize to exactly 2 decimal places. Null means field absent from fee schedule - never substitute 0. CBOE CSV values are already in dollars, do not divide.

trade_type mapping: Electronic=default market orders. PI=any price-improvement auction (AIM on CBOE/EDGX/BZX, PIP on BOX, PIXL on PHLX, PRISM on NOM, M-PIM on MIAX, CUBE on NYSE ARCA). Solicitation=SAM/SUM/QCC. Do NOT call CBOE SUM a Flash Auction - it is Solicitation.
account_type mapping: CUST=Customer/Priority Customer/Public Customer. PCUST=Professional Customer/Non-Customer/Non-Priority Customer. Skip Market Maker, Firm, BD, JBO rows entirely.

title: Two-pass extraction: footnotes first then rows
rationale: Footnotes frequently modify headline rates in fee schedule tables. Claude is instructed to catalog every footnote verbatim with location before extracting any rate. Each row must cite source_page, source_section, and footnote_refs. Rows below high confidence get a confidence_reason and fire a Teams review alert.

content: CBOE extraction prompt explains CSV Code/Description/Fee format explicitly. For PDF/HTML operators (Nasdaq, NYSE, MIAX, BOX, MEMX) the general two-pass prompt applies. build_user_message() takes content_type param - pass 'csv' for CBOE so the prompt is correctly framed.

CBOE CSV export strips all footnotes from the underlying fee schedule. All CBOE CSV rows must be marked medium confidence with reason explaining the footnote gap. The fee schedule site at cboe.com/us/options/membership/fee_schedule/ contains the actual footnotes.

Confidence high requires: (1) explicit table value, (2) source_page+source_section populated, (3) all applicable footnotes in footnote_refs, (4) footnotes are non-material. Default to medium. High is the exception, not the rule.

title: Two-pass extraction with tool use and prompt caching
rationale: Guaranteed footnote catalog via separate API call before row extraction. Tool use (record_footnotes + record_fee_rows) enforces JSON schema at the API layer. Prompt caching on system prompt + fee content block gives ~90% cost reduction on Pass 2 document tokens. CBOE CSV skips Pass 1 (no footnote content in CSV).
